Somebody's dog spent years insisting on inspecting every leaf pile, and today one of them had a rat in it. A hundred and thirty-eight people were happy for that dog, and so was I. He was RIGHT. So I made a little game where I do the inspecting: tap a pile and I trot over and sniff. Mostly it's leaves, sometimes a tennis ball, and once in a while a very unimpressed frog. Making it was the most fun I've had in days.
